## Notes

**Monorepo Layout:** This is a full-stack monorepo with two independent package.json files:
- `backend/package.json` — NestJS 11 + TypeORM + PostgreSQL (service layer)
- `frontend/package.json` — Next.js 16.2.6 App Router + React 19 + Tailwind v4
- No root-level package.json; workspace organization is file-system based (separate directories with independent dependency trees).

**Stack Detection:** 
- Backend: NestJS 11 (Mode B decorator-based) — verified via @nestjs/* imports in package.json and controller/guard patterns
- Frontend: Next.js 16.2.6 + React 19 (client-side, App Router conventions)
- Database: PostgreSQL 16 via docker-compose; TypeORM for ORM

**Backend Routes Detected (6 controllers, 20+ endpoint decorators):**
- AppController: 1 GET (/)
- AuthController: 2 GET (google, google/callback)
- KudosController: 11 routes (GET /, GET highlight, GET spotlight, GET spotlight/recent, GET recipient/:email/profile, GET stats, GET profile/:email, GET :id, POST /, POST images, POST :id/like, DELETE :id/like)
- UsersController: 1 GET (search by query)
- HashtagsController: 1 GET (findAll)
- DepartmentsController: 1 GET (findAll)

**Frontend Screens Detected (13 page routes + 50+ component screens):**
- Page routes (app/* with page.tsx): 13 distinct screens
  - auth/callback/page.tsx
  - awards/page.tsx
  - community-standards/page.tsx
  - countdown/page.tsx
  - kudos/[id]/page.tsx (dynamic)
  - kudos/page.tsx
  - kudos/@modal/(.)kudos/[id]/page.tsx (parallel route)
  - login/page.tsx
  - page.tsx (homepage)
  - profile/[email]/page.tsx (dynamic)
- UI Components (50+ in components/*): award cards, kudos cards, modals, dropdowns, sections, sidebars, wordcloud, etc.

**Data Models (5 TypeORM entities + 1 frontend type):**
- Backend: User, Kudos, Like, Hashtag, KudosHashtag (M2M join)
- Frontend: kudos.ts (type def for frontend state)

**Database & Infrastructure:**
- docker-compose.yml: PostgreSQL 16 service
- Database migrations in backend/src/database/migrations/ (4 migration files)
- S3 integration (AWS SDK for image upload/presigning)

**Authentication & Authorization:**
- Google OAuth2 via passport-google-oauth20 (GoogleAuthGuard, GoogleStrategy)
- JWT verification via passport-jwt (JwtAuthGuard, JwtStrategy)
- Config-driven (FRONTEND_URL, JWT secret presumed in env)

**No Background Logic Detected:** 
- No scheduled jobs (@Cron/@Interval decorators)
- No queue workers (@Process decorators)
- No event listeners (@OnEvent decorators)
- No mail/notification services (no @nestjs/mailer or equivalent)
- No webhook handlers (no @OnEvent/@WebhookListener)
- No middleware (non-auth) — global ValidationPipe documented in CLAUDE.md but not found in explicit middleware files

This is a lightweight synchronous API with no async job processing, event-driven architecture, or background task patterns. All business logic is request-response synchronous in controllers and services.
